description: Posts one past event (event_id from read webhook_deliveries) to one webhook (webhook_id) again now, as Resend in its delivery log does; events are kept 7 days. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: webhook_resend
title: Resend an event to a webhook
